properties.why: A small tree on the lawn at the east edge of audit cell c_-6_-6 (proposed crown C1, left 'unsure' by the first pass), in neither the city inventory nor OpenStreetMap. It is a dense, round, dark crown 3.6 m across in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023, and it stands in a bare mulch ring of the kind left round a planted tree in the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs (spring 2023 and spring 2025). Whether it is broadleaved or evergreen is not clear, so no leaf type is set; height is left to the pipeline's estimate from the crown.

A young tree standing in a ring of worn bare soil on the lawn at the west edge of audit cell c_-4_-6 (proposed crown C1, left 'unsure' by the first pass), in neither the city inventory nor OpenStreetMap. Its crown is a dark irregular clump about 3 m across in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023, and the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photograph of spring 2025 shows bare branches at the centre of the ring. Whether it is broadleaved or evergreen is not clear, so no leaf type is set; height is left to the pipeline's estimate from the crown.
